title: Rav Ada Mari
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Zevachim 38a](https://www.sefaria.org/Zevachim.38a.9), Rava credits his explanation to Bar Ada Mari in the text Hyman uses. Hyman reports the reading Rav Ada Mari in Dikdukei Soferim. In [Moed Katan 16a](https://www.sefaria.org/Moed_Katan.16a.11), Ada Mari speaks in the name of Nechemyah bar Barukh, etc.[^1]

notes.text: The consulted Zevachim 38a has Rava say that Bar Ada Mari explained the point to him. Moed Katan 16a has untitled Ada Mari reporting Nechemyah bar Baruch, who reports Rav Chiyya bar Avin and Rav Yehudah. Hyman's full Rav heading and his reported Dikdukei Soferim reading are preserved; the apparatus report was not directly collated.
